title: Zero-Downtime Moving Target Defense in Software-Defined Networks: Stateful Make-Before-Break Mutation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
description: Official reproducibility artifact for the Elsevier Array manuscript. Provides a stateful, zero-downtime Moving Target Defense (MTD) framework for Software-Defined Networks (SDN) integrating an OpenFlow 1.3 Make-Before-Break (MBB) dual-table pipeline (Table 0 Active and Table 1 Grace), an information-theoretic L2/L3/L4 threat detector, and an 8-dimensional Multi-Objective MDP solved via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with Sim-to-Real fine-tuning on a 16-host, 2-Spine / 4-Leaf Containernet + Open vSwitch testbed.
